SEQUOIA DISTRIBUTION PACKAGES

Use Sequoia-Eleven-Installer.tar.xz for a complete installation.
The other archives support separate component installation; they are optional.
dist/widgets/ and the extracted widgets/ folder from sequoia-widgets.tar.gz contain identical files.
Every archive has a matching .sha256 file. Verify it from that archive’s folder with sha256sum -c FILENAME.sha256.

Sequoia-Eleven-Installer.tar.xz
  Recommended complete installer, editable sources, grid/picker integration; builds native components on the destination machine.

sequoia-widgets.tar.gz
  Widget-only bundle: eight widget archives and installer. Native widgets require matching Qt/KDE. Grid placement needs the main installer’s Plasma style.

icons-only-task-manager-animated.tar.gz
  Standalone animated task manager, retaining the checked-in package and its native compatibility manifest.

sequoia-eleven-light-2.0.0.tar.gz
  Standalone light Plasma style.

sequoia-eleven-dark-2.0.0.tar.gz
  Standalone dark Plasma style.

sequoia-eleven-wallpaper-2.0.0.tar.gz
  Standalone adaptive wallpaper.

sequoia-tahoe-icons-2.0.0.tar.gz
  Standalone icon family with light/dark variants and licenses.

widgets/start-menu.tar.gz
  Standalone Sequoia Start Menu for the widget archive installer.

widgets/downloads.tar.gz
  Downloads widget; also included in the matching bundle.

widgets/separator.tar.gz
  Dock Separator widget; also included in the matching bundle.

widgets/icons-only-task-manager-animated.tar.gz
  Animated task manager with native compatibility manifest.

widgets/system-tray.tar.gz
  System Tray including its styled child widgets and Trash; native compatibility checked before installation.

widgets/sequoia-analog-clock.plasmoid
  Standalone Analog Clock: Sequoia and Original presets; install with kpackagetool6 --type Plasma/Applet --install PACKAGE.

widgets/sequoia-digital-clock.plasmoid
  Standalone Digital Clock review package, including settings and calendar; install with kpackagetool6.

widgets/sequoia-grid-test.plasmoid
  Optional grid development/test widget; install with kpackagetool6. Guided placement requires the matching grid/picker integration.

Rebuild: python3 tools/build-dist.py
Audit: python3 tools/verify-dist.py
The obsolete desktop source archive and task-progress repair ZIP were retired. Their source/tools are available in the complete installer.
